info.title: Fulcrum REST API OpenAPI component subset
info.description: Checked-in subset of https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fulcrumapp/api/v2/reference/rest-api.json covering SCHEMA_MAPPINGS in tools/format-validator/lib/schema-contract.mjs. When adding a mapping, copy that component schema and every $ref it reaches.

FormRecordLinkFieldElement.description: A field that links to records in another form in this account. form_id is required and must be the resource id of an existing form. At least one of allow_existing_records or allow_creating_records must be true. The API does not apply a default when an allow flag is omitted. The account plan must have record links enabled, or the form is rejected. Unknown keys are dropped. Saving without a link is the universal required boolean, not a RecordLink property. linked_form_id and allow_empty_records are not element attributes.

form_id.description: Resource id of an existing form in this account whose records can be linked. This is the element attribute. linked_form_id is not a Forms API element attribute and is dropped.

allow_existing_records.description: Allow selecting existing records from the linked form. At least one of allow_existing_records or allow_creating_records must be true. The API does not default a missing value. The form builder writes true; that is not an API default.

allow_creating_records.description: Allow creating a new record in the linked form from the mobile app. This is a form-schema flag, not a record-creation API. At least one of allow_existing_records or allow_creating_records must be true. The API does not default a missing value. The form builder writes false; that is not an API default.

allow_updating_records.description: Allow editing a linked record inline. Omitted values are stored as false. The form builder writes false; that is not an API request default.

allow_multiple_records.description: Allow linking more than one record. Omitted values are stored as false. When true, record_defaults are ignored and not stored. The form builder writes false; that is not an API request default.

record_conditions_type.description: Whether all or any record_conditions must match. Null when there are no conditions. When conditions are present and this is omitted or not "all", it is stored as "any".

record_conditions.description: Filters which linked-form records can be selected. Null when there are no conditions. Each serialized item has linked_form_field_key, operator, and either value or value_field_key; missing input keys are not rejected.

record_defaults.description: Values copied onto a newly created linked record. Null when unset. Ignored and not stored when allow_multiple_records is true. Each serialized item has source_field_key and destination_field_key; missing input keys are not rejected.

default_previous_value.description: When true, the mobile app pre-fills the previously used link. Omitted values are stored as false.

FormRecordLinkCondition.description: A filter on which records from the linked form can be selected. Rails does not require these keys on input: missing linked_form_field_key or operator is serialized as null. The serialized item contains value_field_key when it is set; otherwise it contains value (which may be null).

linked_form_field_key.description: Key of the field on the linked form that is tested.

operator.description: Comparison operator. The form builder writes equal_to, not_equal_to, contains, starts_with, greater_than, less_than, is_empty, or is_not_empty. Choice, classification, and yes/no fields use equal_to, not_equal_to, is_empty, and is_not_empty.

value.description: Literal JSON value compared against the linked form field. Rails preserves its JSON type and serializes value (possibly null) when value_field_key is not set.

value_field_key.description: Key of a field on this form whose value is compared against the linked form field. When set, this takes precedence over value in the serialized item.

FormRecordLinkDefault.description: Copies a value from a field on this form into a field on a newly created linked record. Rails does not require either key on input; missing keys are serialized as null. Ignored and not stored when allow_multiple_records is true.

source_field_key.description: Key of the field on this form whose value is copied.

destination_field_key.description: Key of the field on the linked form that receives the copied value.

FormBaseElement.description: Common properties shared by all form elements

key.description: Unique 4-character hex key identifying this element within the form (e.g. 'af72')

data_name.description: Snake-case column name used in exports and the query API (e.g. 'park_name')

description.description: Help text shown below the field label

required.description: Whether a value is required to save the record

disabled.description: Whether the field is read-only in the mobile app

hidden.description: Whether the field is hidden by default

default_value.description: Default value pre-populated when a new record is created. Type depends on the element type.

visible_conditions_type.description: Whether ALL or ANY visible conditions must be met. Null means no conditions.

visible_conditions.description: Conditions that control when this element is visible

required_conditions_type.description: Whether ALL or ANY required conditions must be met. Null means no conditions.

required_conditions.description: Conditions that control when this element becomes required

FormElementCondition.description: A visibility or required condition rule applied to a form element

field_key.description: The key of the field being tested

value.description: The value to compare against (may be null for is_empty/is_not_empty operators)
